name: file_inspect
description:
Inspects a local file without reading its full contents. Returns path, size, extension, detected text/binary type, encoding estimate, SHA-256 hash, line count for text files, and a bounded preview.
Use when: deciding how to safely read or process a file before using a data tool.
Scope: local filesystem only. Read-only; previews are capped at 8 KB.
Not for: searching many files (use file_search), profiling structured data (use data_profile), or modifying files.

path.description: Absolute or relative path to a readable local file.

preview_bytes.description: Bytes to preview from the file start. Default: 2048. Max: 8192.
